summary: Repaired all Chronicle-layer F1 defeq breaks. RRelation.lean: 4 sites (not the plan's predicted 2) -- neg_allFuture_neg_to_someFuture/neg_allPast_neg_to_somePast repaired via mcs_not_allFuture_iff/mcs_not_allPast_iff + mcs_not_mem_of_neg feeding the unchanged DNE body; someFuture_H_neg_G_P_absurd/somePast_G_neg_H_F_absurd needed a new DerivationTree-level pattern (contrapositive of the bridge axioms allFuture_to_classic/allPast_to_classic via the contraposition helper, composed with impTrans). Seeds.lean: F_neg_of_G_not/P_neg_of_H_not repaired via mcs_allFuture_iff/mcs_allPast_iff .mpr as predicted; F_mem_of_g_content_sub (not named in plan) needed the same DerivationTree-level bridge-axiom-plus-contraposition pattern via classic_to_allFuture. Structures.lean: the named :157 site needed NO change -- it unfolds gContent's own definition (stated directly in terms of primitive allFuture), not the old G-equiv-negF-neg defeq; genuinely verify-only. Frame.lean (plan said verify-only, was wrong): g_content_set_consistent/h_content_set_consistent had the same G(bot)/H(bot) defeq break as Phase 4/5's mcs_g_bot_not_mem pattern; repaired via mcs_allFuture_iff/mcs_allPast_iff .mp. Undiscovered transitive dependency (mirrors Phase 5's GeneralizedNecessitation finding): Seeds.lean imports Metalogic/CompletenessHelpers.lean, which had 10 of its own F1 breaks -- mcs_g_bot_not_mem/mcs_h_bot_not_mem (bot sites, simple mcs_allFuture_iff/mcs_allPast_iff .mp), mcs_g_trans/mcs_h_trans (new two-stage repair: MCS-level bridge via mcs_not_allFuture_iff/mcs_not_allPast_iff PLUS a DerivationTree-level bridge-axiom-contrapositive lifted through F/H via necessitation + right_mono_until/right_mono_since, since the broken step was nested under a someFuture/somePast operator), and past_of_future_subset/future_of_past_subset (simple .mp conversions). Added 'public import Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Metalogic.GeneralizedNecessitation' to CompletenessHelpers.lean to bring the contraposition helper into scope (verified no import cycle). All 3 plan-required scoped builds GREEN (RRelation, PointInsertion.Seeds, CounterexampleElimination.Structures), plus Frame.lean, OrderedSeedConsistency.lean, PointInsertion/Splitting.lean, PointInsertion/Since.lean (bonus verification) all GREEN. Zero sorry across the entire Chronicle tree + CompletenessHelpers.lean (grep-confirmed). lean_verify on neg_allFuture_neg_to_someFuture and mcs_g_trans: only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound, no new axioms beyond the 4 pre-existing bridge axioms. Fixed 2 lint-style long-line warnings introduced mid-dispatch in CompletenessHelpers.lean before final commit-readiness. Plan file: Phase 6 heading flipped [NOT STARTED] -> [COMPLETED] with full task-level documentation of all deviations from the plan's predicted site list.

continuation_context.notes: Phase 7 targets Chronicle/TruthLemma.lean: add truth_lemma_allFuture/truth_lemma_allPast via reduction to the ALREADY-PROVEN standalone lemmas truth_lemma_untl_forward/backward, truth_lemma_imp, truth_lemma_bot (explicit-IH lemmas per F6/D4 -- no new canonical-model/coherence lemma needed). Reusable MCS bridge lemmas (Cslib.Logic.Temporal namespace, MCS.lean): mcs_allFuture_iff/mcs_allPast_iff (positive form: GX in Omega iff neg(someFuture(neg X)) in Omega) and mcs_not_allFuture_iff/mcs_not_allPast_iff (negated form: GX not-in Omega iff someFuture(neg X) in Omega). NEW pattern discovered in Phase 6 for TruthLemma to watch for: when a defeq break occurs on a formula NESTED under a temporal modality (G/H) or inside another implication's codomain (not top-level MCS membership), the fix is NOT just mcs_allFuture_iff/mcs_allPast_iff -- it requires a DerivationTree-level bridge: take the relevant bridge axiom (Axiom.allFuture_to_classic/classic_to_allFuture/allPast_to_classic/classic_to_allPast), optionally its contrapositive via the `contraposition` helper (Cslib.Logic.Temporal.Metalogic.contraposition, defined in GeneralizedNecessitation.lean -- fully qualify or open the Metalogic namespace if calling from Cslib.Logic.Temporal namespace directly, e.g. CompletenessHelpers.lean needed `Metalogic.contraposition`), then lift through the temporal modality via necessitation (temporal_necessitation/pastNecessitation) + the mono axiom (right_mono_until/right_mono_since) + modus_ponens, exactly mirroring the existing in-file DNE-lifting idiom (e.g. RRelation.lean's original h_g_dne/h_bx3 block, or CompletenessHelpers.mcs_g_trans's new Stage B). truth_lemma_allFuture's F6 sketch (deriving IHs for neg-phi and top from a single ih_phi via MCS negation-completeness) may hit exactly this nested-modality pattern if the compound untl-based construction needs a G/H-level (not just F/P-level) conversion step -- test candidates with lean_multi_attempt before committing to a derivation shape (Risk R3 in the plan). Guard/event slot mapping to confirm: F-X = untl top X against someFuture phi = untl top phi (Formula.lean:68).
